documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Intimation To The Holders Of Physical Shares To Furnish KYC Details

analysis.summary: Management reported that Q1 FY27 revenue grew 23% year-on-year to Rs. 309 crore, driven by healthy order inflows and strong momentum across domestic and export markets. Operating margins are expected to remain stable, supported by an improved product mix, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization. The ongoing Rs. 80 crore modernization and expansion capex program is funded through internal cash generation without additional leverage.

guidance.claim: Management sees potential to improve EBITDA margins by an additional 100 to 200 basis points over coming periods.
guidance.quote: So I think on a similar trajectory, you can see that happen, for another 100, 200 basis points going forward over the coming periods.

guidance.claim: The company expects EBITDA margin improvements to materialize over the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: But surely over the next few quarters, you will see EBITDA margin improvements happening.

guidance.claim: Management expects the restructured process equipment flare product line to achieve revenue around INR 20 crores.
guidance.quote: I think we should be all right for the process equipment flare from approximately a INR20 crores kind of number that I am talking to you about.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that automation remains a strategic priority as rising labour costs increase demand for productivity and efficiency.
demand_outlook.quote: Automation remains a strategic priority as rising labour costs increase demand for productivity and efficiency.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted good demand trends in export markets over recent weeks.
demand_outlook.quote: we have seen demand through the last few weeks even be good.

demand_outlook.claim: Order book, inquiry levels, and approvals indicate better performance for export markets.
demand_outlook.quote: So far this year, what we have seen is the order book, inquiry base, and approvals where we are set up, exports should do better -- should do well, should do better for the markets we operate in.

demand_outlook.claim: Heavy engineering and structural fabrication remain the primary end-market demand drivers for the company.
demand_outlook.quote: Heavy engineering, structural fabrication will remain the big driver because that is a large part of it.

demand_outlook.claim: Order pipeline and inquiry activity in Saudi Arabia have been healthier since December.
demand_outlook.quote: In the last three-four months, it has been a little healthier than what we saw, I would say from December onwards it has been a little healthier than what we saw during calendar year '25.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects capex for the coming year to be approximately INR 30 crores to INR 35 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capex is generally in the region of approximately INR30 crores-INR35 crores for the coming year.

capex_expansion.claim: Annual maintenance capex runs in the range of INR 10 crores to INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, so we have generally a maintenance capex and it will come anywhere in the region of INR10 crores-INR12 crores type scenario.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is introducing two to three new lines in consumables, with total capex potentially reaching up to INR 40 crores per year over the next two years.
capex_expansion.quote: And this year we will have two-three lines that are coming that are new that are for this year and next year. So we expect INR30 crores- INR35 crores, even it could stretch it out to INR40 maybe at the most over the next two years, each year.

capex_expansion.claim: Doubling volume over five to seven years would require approximately INR 100 crores to INR 150 crores in plant and machinery capex.
capex_expansion.quote: I will say anywhere in the region of INR100 crores to INR150 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Operating margins are expected to remain at similar levels supported by an improving product mix, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization.
margins_costs.quote: Operating margins are expected to remain at similar levels, supported by an improving product mix, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization.

margins_costs.claim: For Q4, revenue grew approximately 3%, EBITDA was INR 38 crores, gross margin was around 36%, and PBT was approximately INR 39 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue growth was approximately 3% for the year -- for Quarter 4, sorry and EBITDA clocked in at approximately INR38 crores, an increase of 200 bps. Gross margin was approximately 36% and the PBT was at approximately INR39 crores.

margins_costs.claim: For the full year standalone, revenue grew about 2%, gross margin was 38%, and EBITDA margin reached 12%.
margins_costs.quote: For the year standalone, revenue is up about 2%, gross margins at 38%, up about 250 bps. The EBITDA margin at 12%.

margins_costs.claim: Operational ROCE on EBITDA stood at approximately 12%, while overall ROCE was approximately 23%.
margins_costs.quote: Return on capital employed is approximately on the operational EBITDA at approximately 12%, and return on capital employed is approximately 23%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's overall capacity utilization across welding lines is estimated at around 70%.
orders_capacity.quote: We are anywhere -- welding has a lot of different types of lines in consumables as well as in equipment, but I would say a fair estimate is anywhere in the region of approximately 70%.

orders_capacity.claim: Certain manufacturing lines currently operate at 90% to 95% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: There are some lines that currently operate at 90%-95% for which we need to undertake capex, some new technologies we need to invest for as well, but yes, pretty much along that.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is currently recording its highest order book to date in welding automation.
orders_capacity.quote: Seeing that benefit coming, we are seeing our best order book for us on the welding automation than we have ever seen.

capital_allocation.claim: Ador Welding successfully recovered INR 14 crores pending from an old Kuwait project.
capital_allocation.quote: The Kuwait project recovery, which was a lot of good work done by the team for the recovery that was pending from 2020-2021, that finally led to INR14 crores of recovery, and PBT of approximately INR130 crores excluding the onerous cost of the Uran project.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is open to targeted technology-focused acquisitions.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we are, yes, we are open. We are open to acquisitions, but our acquisitions are a little more targeted now.

risks_headwinds.claim: Legal proceedings regarding BIS hearings are continuing in magistrate court.
risks_headwinds.quote: So the BIS hearings, most of it is closed, but it still got to go back to magistrate court, which we have been given a date sometime in June-July.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has appealed against an income tax demand of approximately INR 14 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: So income tax matter, we have filed our appeal last week only and we don't see any merit, means that the department will succeed in that.

management_commitments.claim: Operating margins are expected to remain at similar levels, supported by product mix improvements, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization.
management_commitments.quote: Operating margins are expected to remain at similar levels, supported by an improving product mix, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects annual capex in the range of INR 30 crores to INR 35 crores for the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: Our capex is generally in the region of approximately INR30 crores-INR35 crores for the coming year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to introduce new lines with annual capex reaching up to INR 40 crores over the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: And this year we will have two-three lines that are coming that are new that are for this year and next year. So we expect INR30 crores- INR35 crores, even it could stretch it out to INR40 maybe at the most over the next two years, each year.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to deliver EBITDA margin improvements over upcoming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: But surely over the next few quarters, you will see EBITDA margin improvements happening.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
